criticalReview.finding: The independent critical agent confirmed the candidate maps only to block_18 / line_18_1 in the right cell; DIRECTION TOKENS maps to line_18_0 in the separate left cell. The selected PDF source line provides a 155.27 pt right-cell width, separate from the 161.07 pt left cell. Live PageRenderer receipts at 100% and 200% both measure 1→1 EXACT with Optima loaded, no frame escape, no blocked writes, and no page errors. Individual captures show no visible clipping or collision. Loa Crystal → Cristal de Loa remains a local compound candidate pending human review. Editor round-trip and exported-PDF validation also remain pending. The review's container-rectangle description was corrected to distinguish the shared field rectangle from the line-derived effective right-cell frame.

applicationReview.finding: After rebuilding the local review catalog and reloading the app, I selected the LOA CRYSTAL TOKEN proposal in the real PT-BR Viewer. Both FICHAS DE DIREÇÃO and FICHA DE CRISTAL DE LOA were visible in their separate Table 10 cells; only the selected right-cell unit received the review highlight. The DOM selection key was page_100_unit_p100-loa-crystal-token-label__pt-BR. This interactive check was observed in the user-facing app; a combined screenshot was not persisted in the evidence directory.

revisions.result: Initial natural candidate preserving the singular item label, retained proper name Loa, and official Token → Ficha glossary entry; the compound remains pending human review.
